note: Logan's seven subjects. Built from the 60-day academy on his desktop (LOGAN_60_DAY_ACADEMY), curriculum/physics.json, curriculum/spaceflight.json and the quant-ml equation registry, with Accounting and Economics authored fresh because the academy did not cover them. Re-cut over 150 weekday lessons, teaching-first: no quizzes, no problem sets, no spaced repetition.

phases.name: Foundations
phases.mission: The quantitative language, the mechanics of motion, and how a business records what it does. Nothing here assumes anything.

phases.name: Core Machinery
phases.mission: Linear algebra and multivariable calculus, electromagnetism, the macroeconomy, and the first real finance.

phases.name: Quantitative Method
phases.mission: Probability and statistics, thermodynamics, valuation, the accounts in anger, and the beginning of machine learning.

phases.name: Advanced
phases.mission: Modern physics, deep learning, derivatives and risk, and the engineering of getting to orbit.

phases.name: Frontier and Synthesis
phases.mission: Transformers and language models, quantum and cosmology, portfolio construction, mission design -- and the connections between them.
